| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}| [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Native American cuisine|Native American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Corn|Corn]] | [[Cookbook:Soups|Soups]]

==Ingredients==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (43.5 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 1.23 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]]) [[Cookbook:Corn|whole kernel corn]]
* 1 can (14.5 oz / 410 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) creamed corn
* 1 box (32 oz / 900 g) chicken [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Cube|cubed]] [[Cookbook:Potatoes|potatoes]]
* 1 can (13 oz / 370 g) [[Cookbook:Chicken#Breast|chicken breast]]
* 1 ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (½ [[Cookbook:Pint|pint]] / 250 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] fresh [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (8 oz / 250 ml) [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]] (optional)
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] non-iodized [[Cookbook:Salt|sea salt]] (optional)
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:MSG|MSG]] (optional)

==Procedure==

=== Cooking ===
#Put all ingredients into stockpot and start cooking slowly over medium heat.
#When the ingredients get warm, put some of them into a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]], liquefy them, and pour back into the pot. This helps thicken the soup.
#Cook until the potatoes get soft all the way through and start getting translucent, stirring every few minutes to get the contents off the bottom of the pot.
#If storing then proceed to the section on long term storage.
#To serve, add ½ cup whole milk, 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] unsalted butter, and ¼ cup romano cheese per pint of hot soup.

=== Short term storage (<3 days) ===
#Refrigerate at under 40°F (2°C) for no more than 3 days.

===Long term storage (>3 days)===
#Pour into 16-[[Cookbook:Ounce|ounce]] (1-pint) mason jars leaving 1 [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (2.5 cm) headspace.
#Process 90 minutes in a pressure canner at 10 (11 for dial) pounds, adjusted for your altitude.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* It is recommended that you use all the optional ingredients or this will taste bland.
